issues.description: The template implementation of simulate_msd_one_round calls stim.Circuit(n_shots) (treating the Circuit constructor as if it accepted a shots parameter). The solution uses stim.Circuit() (no shots argument). This inconsistency is misleading: Stim's Circuit constructor takes an optional number-of-qubits argument, not a number-of-shots, so passing n_shots in the template is incorrect and may confuse students about how to construct a Circuit.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template to construct the Stim circuit without passing n_shots (use stim.Circuit() ) or clearly document the meaning of the constructor argument. Replace circ = stim.Circuit(n_shots) with circ = stim.Circuit() in the template simulate_msd_one_round stub so it matches the solution and the intended usage.
